name: Privileges Of Saints
overview: The privileges of saints are vividly illustrated in the dialogue between Abraham and the LORD, where God assures Abram of His protection and great reward, emphasizing the intimate access believers have to God through faith. Abraham's bold intercession for the righteous in Sodom demonstrates the saints' privilege to call upon God in trouble and to engage with Him confidently, trusting in His justice and mercy. These passages reveal that saints are granted a unique relationship with God marked by divine protection, intercession, and an assured inheritance.
